text:
ana: FYI launching two Dedicated pools with NVIDIA A10G in eu-west-3a and sa-east-1a today.

ana: Pools: `dedicated-a10g-eu-west-3a` (32 cards) and `dedicated-a10g-sa-east-1a` (12 cards). These are intended for cost-sensitive inference and batch workloads. Pilot capacity for 72h.

chris: Any immediate policy changes? Last pilot had noisy neighbor issues.

ana: Yes 1) default cross-tenant burst cap = 18% per pool; 2) burst opt-in requires Ops approval. Reserved & committed contracts unaffected.

sales-ops: Need quick blurb for AE outreach and pricing delta vs H100.

ana: Short guidance: A10G approx 50% lower unit cost on int8 paths for short/medium contexts; H100 still recommended for sub-20ms p99 or >16k contexts. Chris will send the one-pager.

sre-bot: Autoscaler set: min_replicas=1, scale_step=3, cooldown=150s. Monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/dedicated-a10g-pilot.

chris: Will coordinate a 48h watch and update the routing table with region_affinity=preferred; no force-migration of reservations.

ana: CLI reserve example:
```
rw-cli dedicated reserve --pool dedicated-a10g-eu-west-3a --count 2 --duration 14d --allow-burst=false
```

sales-ops: Great, ping when the AE blurb is ready.
